introduction: Scope: registered GOODTIMES WL6 historical source and native SDL3 engine. This is a reviewed directed-route inventory, not an exhaustive enumeration of every branch/input combination.

Evidence records distinguish source review, native regression assertions and execution of the checksum-verified original DOS executable. Current run results are in [Milestone 13](MILESTONE13_FINAL_FIDELITY.md).

presentation.title: Continuous executed-DOS comparison incomplete
presentation.finding: 30 controlled indexed frames and four sound-off demo state traces do not establish all intermediate fades, gameplay composites, victory/article/name-entry or death frames.
presentation.close_with: Capture synchronized original DOS intermediate framebuffer/palette/input/audio records for these journeys.

cache.title: Native cache and I/O cadence
cache.finding: Native heap residency and bounded reads replace DOS main/EMS/XMS budgets and disk speed; exact page counts and duration differ.
cache.close_with: Treat as intentional adaptation; compare visual progress formula separately from hardware-dependent duration.

entry-fizzle.title: Gameplay-entry reveal differs
entry-fizzle.finding: DOS GameLoop sets fizzlein; Revive uses a 30-tic palette fade after loading and redraws immediately on death restart. Neither reproduces DOS ThreeDRefresh/FizzleFade gameplay-entry reveal. This is an acknowledged visual difference, not pixel parity.
entry-fizzle.close_with: Implement and independently compare DOS entry fizzle before claiming complete presentation equivalence.

fizzle-clip.title: Safe red-fizzle clipping
fizzle-clip.finding: Revive clips to the active viewport; DOS FizzleFade accepts x==width/y==height and can overdraw border pixels.
fizzle-clip.close_with: Retain safe clipping as an intentional difference unless a bounded compatible renderer is separately demonstrated.

storage.title: Portable storage/error flows
storage.finding: Six versioned atomic native saves and separate score/config files replace DOS ten-slot formats. Native I/O/error and disk-flip phases differ.
storage.close_with: Document compatibility boundary; keep corruption, atomic failure and restart regressions passing.

hardware.title: Portable hardware, input and debug adaptations
hardware.finding: No ISA/gameport/EMS/XMS detection, BIOS text mode, controller calibration or DOS timing/cache debug emulation. Native display/binding panels and startup plumbing differ.
hardware.close_with: Document unsupported hardware/editions and verify actual native devices separately.

ui-rng.title: Separate UI entropy
ui-rng.finding: Quit-message selection uses separate native UI entropy, preserving gameplay/demo RNG rather than consuming original US_RndT.
ui-rng.close_with: Retain intentional separation and test original saying selection precedence independently.

audio.title: Physical FM/PCM balance unverified
audio.finding: The current wide-accumulator ×4 FM gain, synth and native volume controls are not calibrated against physical OPL/Sound Blaster output. Scheduling/priority tests do not establish loudness parity. DOS UpdateFace skips RNG while GETGATLINGSND is playing; the native engine intentionally retains audio-independent face/RNG updates. The four reference demos use DOS sound off. DOS Died also calls SD_WaitSoundDone after acknowledgement; native death has no separate sound-completion gate. The existing fizzle/wait usually outlasts the effect, but early acknowledgement versus FM completion is not independently verified.
audio.close_with: Measure representative enabled-DOS tracks/effects against a documented device/reference before changing gain.

statuses.source-reviewed: Source correspondence inspected; no runtime or pixel-equivalence claim.
statuses.partial: Known intentional difference or verification gap remains; see linked findings.

boundaries: - GOODTIMES registered WL6 only: no shareware locks, SPEAR/JAPAN/SPANISH layouts or non-GOODTIMES help remapping.

- Original software raycaster and fixed-point 70 Hz rules remain shared by Classic and Enhanced. Modern controls, interpolation, six native saves, settings/score formats and volume controls are intentional adaptations.
- Physical DOS CRT/DAC/OPL, native Windows/macOS, WebAssembly and Android are not certified. Dummy SDL/Wine tests establish only their stated scope. No Android controls are introduced.
